summary.text: Jake Fey is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 27-Position 2 since January 14, 2013, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Fey chaired the House Transportation Committee and was assigned to the Environment & Energy Committee during the 2023-2024 session, and served as vice chair of the Joint Oregon-Washington Legislative Action Committee, according to Ballotpedia.
